paite: Huai Melkisedek, Salemkumpipa Tungnungpen Siampu, Abraham kumpipate that hongpai na dawn a vualzawlpa,
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

paite: Abraham in bangkim ah sawmakhat a pia. Amin khiakna genchian in amasa pen in Diktatna Kumpipa, azom nawn in Salem Kumpipa ahinawna; huaituh Lemna Kumpipa chihna ahi.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace;

paite: Amahtuh pa neilou in, nu neilou in, khangthu bei, ompatni neilou hintawpni leng neisamlou in. Pathian tapa bang a siam tangtawn a siampu hi gige ahi zaw hi.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

paite: Huchi in, chikhah Abraham in a galllak hoihpeuhmah laka sawmakhat apiakna pa, huaimipa thupi dan ngaihtuah dih ua.
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best spoils.

paite: Levi suante laka siampuna tang peuhmah in dan thu bangin mite lak ah sawmakhat lak ding thu amu ngei uhi, huaituh a unaute uh lak ah ahi, huaite tuh Abraham khal a pawt hisam mahle u leng.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

paite: Himahleh, alak ua a suante suikhawmsak sam louh pan Abraham lak ah sawmakhat ala a, thuchiamte kempa tuh vual ana zawlta hi.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

paite: Himahleh, sel vuallouhin a neujaw tuh thupi zaw vualzawl sak in a om hi.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

paite: Huan, hiai ah mihing si zel ten sawmakhat a mu ua, huai ah bel, ahing nilouh, chi a, a thu a theisak un a mu ahi.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

paite: Huan, Levi, sawmakhat lazelpa nangawn in, Abraham khut ah sawmakhatte a peta, chih theih ahi;
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

paite: Melkisedek in a na dawn lai in apakhal ah a om lai- ngal a.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

paite: Huchiin, Levi ten siampu hihna ziaka bukimna muhtheih na hi leh (huainuai ah miten tuh dan thu ana mu ngal ua), Aaron omdan bang a bawl louh Melkisedek omdan bang a siampu dang hong om bang kiphamawh ding ahia?
english: Now if there were perfection through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

paite: Siampu hihna tuh ahong lamdan tak ziakin dan thu tuh hihlamdan sam a hong kiphamawh himhim ahi.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

paite: Hiai a thu agenpa namtuam mi ahi ngal a, huai nam laka a mi tuh kuamah maitam ah a gamtang ngeikei uhi.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

paite: I Toupa lah Juda nam lak a hong suak ahi chih a kichian ngal a: Huai nam thu ah tuh Mosi in siampu te lam thu bangmah a gen kei hi.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

paite: Huan, Melkisedek bang a siampu dang hong suah tuh nakpi takin I thugen pen a kichian nawn diak hi;
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

paite: Amahtuh sa thupiak dan thu bang a siam bang hilou, hin tawpneilou thil hihtheihna bang zaw a, siam ahi.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life:

paite: Nang zaw, Melkisedek omdan bang a khantawn a siampu na hi chih theihsak ahi ngala.
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.” Psalm 110:4

paite: Ahatlouh leh a phattuamlouhna ziakin thupiak awm masa tuh paihkhiak ahi.
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

paite: (Dan thu in bangmah a hihkim ngal kei a). Lametna hoih zaw, Pathian I naihna zel tuh, pilutin a om zawta hi.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

paite: Huan, kichiamna tellou lou-in amah tuh Siampu a bawl ahita hi:
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

paite: Amau zaw kichiamlou a siampu a siam ahi ngal ua; amah bel, nang zaw khantawna Siampu na hi, chi in, Toupa a kichiam a, ka khelkik kei ding, chi a a kiang a genpa khut ah kichiam in:
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’” Psalm 110:4

paite: Huchitaka thupi in Jesu tuh thukhun hoih zaw hihkip pa a hong hita hi.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.

paite: Huan, amau zaw sih ziaka omden theilou ahih ziakun, siampu a siam a tam ngei ua;
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

paite: Amahbel khantawna a om gige ziakin, a Siampu hihna tuh khen theih vuallouh in a nei zaw hi.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

paite: Huchiin, amaha Pathian kianga hongpaite tuh a tawp dong in a hondam thei ahi, amau thumsak in khantawna a hin gige ziak in.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

paite: Huchibang Siampu Lianpen, misiangthou, zulhzau lou, ninbanglou, khialte laka omtuam, vante sang a tungnung zaw a, siam, tuh eia ding in a kilawm him hi.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

paite: Aman tuh huai siampu lianpente lat bang in, niteng in amah khelh ziak a kithoihna lan masa phawt a, huainung a mite khelhna ziaka lat a kiphamoh kei; Amah a kilat laitak in setden ding in khat vei in ana hihkhinta ngal a,Dan thu in, mihing hatlouhna neite tuh, siampu lianpen ding in a sep zel a; ki chiam thu, dan thu nung a a hong om in bel, Tapa, khantawna ding a hihkim khitsa tuh, asep zouta ahi.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

paite: Dan thu in, mihing hatlouhna neite tuh, siampu lianpen ding in a sep zel a; ki chiam thu, dan thu nung a a hong om in bel, Tapa, khantawna ding a hihkim khitsa tuh, asep zouta ahi.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath which came after the law appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
